title: Batch dashboard/summary into 1-2 CTEs
description: The dashboard summary endpoint runs 10 separate database queries in sequence, taking 2.1 seconds. Combining them into 1-2 CTEs (Common Table Expressions) would drop it to under 300ms. Same pattern for settings/keys (14 queries, 1.8s).
impact: Dashboard loads 7x faster for every user on every page load

title: Fix remaining tenant_id gaps in UPDATE queries
description: 7 more UPDATE queries in review.py, agents.py, learning_extraction.py, and youtube_sync.py are missing AND tenant_id in WHERE clauses. Same pattern as the 7 just fixed. Lower risk since most don't take user-controlled IDs, but still defense-in-depth gaps.
impact: Complete tenant isolation across all backend routes
